purpose: Measure whether P0723 formula rankings and predictions are artifacts of grid resolution, boundary proximity, or one vertical-prior draw.

systemRoles.DDO101: largest observational mismatch for every P0723 manifest

scenarios.role: 1.5x transverse box at baseline transverse cell spacing

interpretation.normalizedPredictionRmse: RMS(variant speed - baseline speed) divided by RMS(baseline speed), paired at identical observed radii.
interpretation.stable: All predeclared stability gates pass; this does not prove convergence beyond the tested range.
interpretation.sensitive: Any stability gate fails; P0723 model differences must not be interpreted without a refined numerical protocol.

claimBoundary: This is a spent-sample numerical sensitivity diagnostic on four deliberately selected sentinel galaxies, not a blind validation.
The expanded-box case tests proximity of the current zero-Dirichlet transverse boundary; it is not an independent isolated-boundary algorithm.
Vertical draws sample declared priors because the available surface maps do not identify unique three-dimensional depth.
Circular speeds test massive tracers only; photon lensing and resolved velocity fields remain outside this stage.
Thresholds classify commissioning stability and must not be changed after results are opened.
